nodes.summary: At a leaf, the brute-force likelihood is the leaf weight.
nodes.title: Brute-force likelihood at a leaf

nodes.summary: The brute-force likelihood factors over the two subtrees of the root (the distributive law behind pruning).
nodes.title: Brute-force likelihood factors over subtrees

nodes.summary: The likelihood of the leaf data conditioned on root state `s`, by brute force: the sum of the weights of all labelings of the non-root nodes.
nodes.title: Brute-force likelihood given the root state

nodes.summary: There are `|S| ^ (2 · #internal nodes)` labelings (one state for each non-root node), so the brute-force sum `bruteLik` has exponentially many terms.
nodes.title: Number of labelings of a tree

nodes.summary: A labeling of the non-root nodes of a tree by states: at every internal node, the states of its two children and labelings of the two subtrees.
nodes.title: Labeling of the non-root nodes of a tree

nodes.summary: The site likelihood from the tabulated partial likelihoods at the root.
nodes.title: Site likelihood from tabulated partial likelihoods

nodes.summary: `likelihood obs t π = ∑ s, π s * prune obs t s`.
nodes.title: The site likelihood by pruning

nodes.summary: The site likelihood with root distribution `π`: `∑ s, π s * bruteLik obs t s`.
nodes.title: Site likelihood of a phylogenetic tree
Number of internal nodes of a tree
Number of leaves of a tree

nodes.summary: Felsenstein's pruning algorithm computes the likelihood conditioned on the root state.
nodes.title: Felsenstein's pruning algorithm computes the likelihood conditioned on the root state

nodes.summary: The tabulated algorithm computes the pruning recursion.
nodes.title: Tabulated pruning computes the pruning recursion

nodes.summary: Felsenstein's pruning algorithm, tabulated on the states `Fin n`: the vector of partial likelihoods of each subtree is computed once, with `O(n²)` operations per internal node.
nodes.title: Tabulated Felsenstein pruning algorithm

nodes.summary: Felsenstein's pruning recursion: the partial likelihood of the subtree `t` given state `s` at its root.
nodes.title: Felsenstein's pruning recursion

nodes.summary: For an alignment whose sites `k : ι` evolve independently along the same tree with leaf data `obs k`, the joint likelihood (the sum over all choices of a root state and a labeling at every site of the product of the per-site weights) is the product of the per-site likelihoods.
nodes.title: Independent sites

nodes.summary: A rooted binary tree with leaf labels `L`; an internal node `node P l Q r` carries the transition weights `P` and `Q` (from the node's state to the child's state) on the edges to its left child `l` and right child `r`.
nodes.title: Rooted binary tree with transition weights

nodes.summary: The weight of a labeling given root state `s`: the product over all edges of the transition weight from the parent's state to the child's state, times the leaf weight `obs l` at the state of every leaf `l`.
nodes.title: Weight of a tree labeling

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
